definitions.gloss: noble; virtuous; having high moral integrity
definitions.explanation: Describes a person of high moral character who is upright, pure in conduct, and free from corruption. A literary and somewhat formal word.

examples.japanese: {高潔|こうけつ}な{人柄|ひとがら}で{知|し}られている。
{高潔|こうけつ}な{精神|せいしん}を{持|も}ち{続|つづ}ける。
{彼|かれ}は{権力|けんりょく}の{誘惑|ゆうわく}にも{屈|くっ}せず、{高潔|こうけつ}な{生|い}き{方|かた}を{貫|つらぬ}いた。
examples.english: He resisted the temptation of power and lived a life of integrity.

notes:
Composed of {高|こう} (high) and {潔|けつ} (clean/pure). Describes moral elevation and purity of character. This is a literary, somewhat formal word used to praise someone's unwavering moral standards.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高潔|こうけつ}な{人物|じんぶつ}: a person of integrity
- {高潔|こうけつ}な{精神|せいしん}: noble spirit
- {高潔|こうけつ}な{人格|じんかく}: noble character/personality
- {高潔|こうけつ}さ: nobility, virtuousness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {清廉|せいれん}: upright / incorruptible — focuses on being free from corruption, especially in public office
- {高尚|こうしょう}: lofty / refined — emphasizes refined tastes or elevated thinking, not necessarily moral purity
- {潔白|けっぱく}: innocent / blameless — focuses on being free from guilt or wrongdoing
- {品格|ひんかく}: dignity / grace — broader term for having refined character
